newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan July offshore banking unit assets edge up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan July offshore banking unit assets edge up.

text.p: The combined assets of Taiwan's 61 offshore banking units grew 2.0 percent to US$34.297 billion at the end of July from a year earlier, the central bank said on Wednesday.
About 76 percent of the assets, held by 34 local banks and 27 foreign banks, came from Asia and the rest from Europe and America, the bank said in a statement.
The bank recently approved one more offshore banking unit application for a foreign bank and two more for local banks.
In July, Taiwan's offshore banking units reported a monthly foreign exchange turnover of $4.358 billion, the bank said.

Of the derivatives operated by the offshore banking units, margin trading accounted for $258 million, financial futures accounted for $207 million, options took $182 million, interest rate swaps took $69 million and forward interest rate agreement took $5 million.
The government plans to expand offshore banking unit business in its scheme to become an Asia-Pacific financial hub.
Officials have said the expansion, whose magnitude has not been disclosed, would herald some tax burden for offshore banking units.
